The objective is the entire implication from the explicitly stated problem (S) to T. The hypothesis and consequent
are separated in shape.quantifiers, shape.missing_input and shape.known_bounds. The threshold of the deduction is 3.
All other shape fields describe their contribution to that implication, with hypothesis-only facts labelled.

The native file layout uses problem, preconditions, ranking and study files for a conditional objective.
The mathematical statement and text here are independently authored. This is a format test, not a research record.
